entries.label: common_0000_system_01a
entries.text: NARANJA ACADEMY

entries.label: common_0000_system_01b
entries.text: UVA ACADEMY

entries.label: common_0000_system_02a
entries.text: TAKING LESSONS FROM TRADITION—\n               GROWING STRONGER AND GREATER

entries.label: common_0000_system_02b
entries.text: LEADING THE WAY INTO THE FUTURE—\n               WHILE VALUING OUR INDIVIDUALITY

entries.label: common_0000_system_03
entries.text: IT’S TIME FOR YOU, TOO...\n      TO DIVE INTO THE WORLD OF POKÉMON!

entries.label: common_0000_system_04a
entries.text: DIRECTOR CLAVELL\nHEAD OF NARANJA ACADEMY

entries.label: common_0000_system_04b
entries.text: DIRECTOR CLAVELL\nHEAD OF UVA ACADEMY

entries.label: common_0000_system_05
entries.text: Paldea is a sprawling region bursting with lush\nnature and magnificent landscapes.

entries.label: common_0000_system_06
entries.text: It is also, of course, home to the mysterious\ncreatures known to us as Pokémon.

entries.label: common_0000_system_06_2
entries.text: They reside here in great numbers, in fact.

entries.label: common_0000_system_07
entries.text: Pokémon can be found living all over: in the seas,\nin the skies—even in our cities and towns.

entries.label: common_0000_system_08
entries.text: We humans coexist with Pokémon, as we both\nhelp one another to live and thrive.

entries.label: common_0000_system_09a
entries.text: Naranja Academy is here to help you learn even\nmore about these precious partners.

entries.label: common_0000_system_09b
entries.text: Uva Academy is here to help you learn even\nmore about these precious partners.

entries.label: common_0000_system_10
entries.text: Within our halls, people from all regions gather\nto study together.

entries.label: common_0000_system_11
entries.text: And as Pokémon Trainers, they have their\nPokémon do battle, growing alongside them...

entries.label: common_0000_system_12
entries.text: while our robust curriculum of coursework helps\nour students draw forth their fullest potential.

entries.label: common_0000_system_13
entries.text: It is within these halls that you will find your\nfriends, your Pokémon, and your true self.

entries.label: common_0000_system_14a
entries.text: We, the faculty and staff at Naranja Academy,\ncan’t wait to welcome you with open arms.

entries.label: common_0000_system_14b
entries.text: We, the faculty and staff at Uva Academy,\ncan’t wait to welcome you with open arms.
